instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. In a sunny, grassy park, the woman in the black beanie (R5) wearing a red t-shirt and blue jeans leans forward with her hands on her knees, looking left. To her right, the Asian man in the red polo (R3) stands watching. In the background, the heavy-set man in black (R1) walks on the left, and the woman in the dark t-shirt (R4) stands in the center. Bright daylight fills the scene.
